description.p: Backups have arrived. Pick any installed app, choose whether to include its data and runtime, and Klia Store packs everything into a single portable archive you can restore later — on this machine or a new one. No terminal commands, no guesswork.

You can now support Klia Store directly from the app: after a successful install, an optional "watch an ad to support" button opens a short ad in your browser. It's entirely optional and takes a few seconds — a small way to help keep the project going if you feel like it.

Fixed an issue where creating a backup with the runtime included could silently fail without producing an archive, and the progress dialog now clearly shows when something goes wrong instead of looking stuck.

You can now install .flatpak files directly by opening them with Klia Store. A dedicated installation dialog shows app metadata, size, and dependencies before confirming, with real-time terminal output during the process.
Added Klia Kompress — a local image compression and conversion tool — as the first app available directly from its GitHub releases, independent of Flathub.
Introduced a separate update-checking system for GitHub-sourced apps that runs in parallel with the Flathub update checker, keeping both paths fully isolated.
SHA256 verification now works correctly for GitLab apps that upload their release archives manually.
Fixed a scroll issue in the installation terminal where an invisible element was causing extra blank space at the bottom of the page.
